title: A Week With Replay QA
subtitle: What it means for you, from Monday to ship day

chapters.title: Monday: Paste a Link
chapters.blurb: Monday morning. Setting this up is one action: you paste your app's address, and that's it.

chapters.title: Tuesday: Bugs That Come With a Movie
chapters.blurb: Tuesday, first coffee. Waiting for you: a short list of real problems, not a wall of alerts.

chapters.title: You Fix It. It Checks.
chapters.blurb: Tuesday, you watched the exact moment your checkout broke. Wednesday morning, you fix it. Took about twenty minutes.

chapters.title: A Month Later
chapters.blurb: A month in, your mornings all look the same. You do your work. It does its walking.
